LESSON: JESUS’ PASSION, DEATH AND RESURRECTION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.6: Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection
2. Practise Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection in the examples.
2. Explain Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection
2. Practise Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
